inject_entries.hint: When enabled, inject the log block (tag, header, entries, inner footer). When disabled, user-message modes inject only the outer footer; system_prompt injects nothing.

tag_name.hint: The tag name that wraps the injected recursion log. Any characters except < > and line breaks are allowed.

header_text.hint: Explanatory text displayed inside the tag, before the first section. Supports \n for line breaks.

inject_position.hint: user_message_before / user_message_after: inject once in the first user message of a new window. system_prompt: append the log to the existing system prompt on every LLM request.

date_format.hint: How timestamps are displayed in the injected log. MM-DD for month-day, YYYY-MM-DD for full date.

inner_footer_text.hint: Text displayed inside the tag, after the last section and before the closing tag. Supports \n for line breaks.

footer_text.hint: Text displayed after the closing tag in user-message modes only. Supports \n for line breaks.
footer_text.default: Below is Felis Abyssalis's live message. Execute from here.

initial_context_count.hint: User-message modes only: inject when context count is at most this value. Set to 0 if no preset, or 2 for one user+assistant preset pair.
